road.sample_rule: verify_roads_v30 station interpolation at 1m and offsets -4..4m every 0.5m; no bridge/water station exclusions
road.cell_rule: exact owning grid cell; both adjacent cells on an exact grid line

bridge.transform_contract: world = WRP position + local P3D vertices @ row-major WRP 3x3; source serialization is float32 WRP matrix
bridge.coverage_policy: union of every face-bearing P3D LOD for every matching WRP object; no LOD labeled as exact collision/physical semantics
limitations: offline projected model-face union; not an in-game collision readback
union conservatively freezes cell intersections from visual, roadway, shadow, or other face-bearing LODs
X/Z projection discards Y and can overprotect bridge-deck and support-beam footprints

policy: All road stations including short chains and crossings; one-cell sampled-road halo; all face-bearing bridge LOD footprints.
limits: Conservative civil freeze, not road grade acceptance or engine collision readback.
Does not replace platform/reserve/summit/P9 or semantic protection masks. No terrain edit.
